In creating a... Uh... All these materials. Do you see yourself in the position of preserving for posterity a recognizable New Orleans style, so that there's a possibility that several generations from now, someone could get interested in the New Orleans style, and actually... Uh... Yeah, I agree. That it could be played, that…

Yeah, I've wondered about it, and thought some about it at times. Sometimes I get discouraged and wonder if there is any interest there will be, too, you know, that, uh, when you look at, uh, how popular the rock stuff has gotten, and the, uh, jazz is just, uh, uh, is the article I was quoting there, Norman, uh, what's his name?
